model.name: Rudy Report Model Board
model.target: Chance of being a first-round pick (and of being drafted at all)
model.train: 55,984 D-I player-seasons, 2007-08 to 2022-23 (805 by later first-round picks)

backtest.text: Fit on 2007-08 to 2017-18 and tested on 2018-19 to 2022-23: the model's top 30 college players each season included 53% eventual first-round picks, and it ranked a random eventual first-rounder above a random non-first-rounder 97% of the time (AUC).

model.comps_pool: Final college seasons of 907 drafted players (2007-08 to 2025-26)
